purpose: Machine-readable raw evidence establishing the provenance of the ADR-0066 recorded Caldera prediction that RUE-1090 consumes, plus this host's configuration and the scaling-bench runner's raw per-sample timings for a checked-in reference corpus.

recorded_prediction.verbatim: hashed typed-key lookup plus D1 machinery deletion will not materially reduce the O(bodies × declarations) per-body installation/projection/endpoint term (~62% of cold wall time at Caldera scale).
recorded_prediction.install_project_endpoint_share_note: The O(bodies × declarations) per-body install/project/endpoint term — the frozen figure the RUE-1090 measurement gate reads. This is the ADR-0066 recorded prediction, restored verbatim.
recorded_prediction.total_per_body_setup_share_note: A SEPARATE figure, not the 62% prediction: the total per-body setup share (install/project/endpoint PLUS prepare and config), measured via the 200-sample stack profile. The two must not be conflated — 62% is the install/project/endpoint share the gate reads, 85% is the total setup share for context.
recorded_prediction.decision_rule: After D1 lands, if the scaling harness shows per-body install/project/endpoint work still increasing with unrelated-declaration count, the shared-base or narrow-epoch repair proceeds; an incidental wall-time improvement without flat per-body counters is not success.
recorded_prediction.hypothesis_status: The 62% figure is a pre-implementation hypothesis (ADR-0066 §3), not repository-proven evidence; this artifact records its measurement provenance so RUE-1090 can consume it.
recorded_prediction.pre_link_north_star_note: Eventual reference-host/corpus project target for warm incremental pre-link compilation; not a language guarantee and not a gate this runner enforces.

environment.RUE_STD_PATH: set to the repository std root ($PWD/std)

commands: gdb stack sampling: 200 samples at 0.25s intervals over the same release <rue> --time-passes invocation

corpus_roots.reference: synthetic single-file main.rue produced by the scaling_harness.rs Corpus generator (reached bodies b{i} each called once from main, unrelated declarations d{j} nothing calls, plus main)

intervals.pre_link: semantic PLUS the backend tail through CFG lowering, code generation, and object-file creation (everything before linking); the instrument for the ~45 ms pre-link target

runner.note: Sample values are nanoseconds. These are this-host release measurements for the reference corpus below, attributable to reference_host.commit; they are not the Caldera corpus and not the 45 ms target itself.

reference_corpus.note: Declaration universe = bodies + decls + 1 (main); cold_bodies = bodies + 1 = 101.
